name: Tokawa Mari
source:
Daughter of Kimie, she is six years older than Jun.

She is a shrine maiden at the Kimigahama Shrine and a strong older sister who supports the shrine with her mother. Jun's appearance, which has changed to that of a man after a long absence, keeps her on edge.

It is said that a priestess must be a virgin. She is actually a non-virgin, although she acts like one. Ever since she was in high school, she has been bringing her boyfriends to shrines to have sex. She has a habit of doing it outdoors.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/momofero/product/mikomama/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
木江的女儿，比纯大六岁。

她是君滨神社的巫女，与母亲一起支撑神社，是个坚强的姐姐。纯久别归来后变得像个男人，这让她一直心神不宁。

据说巫女必须是处女。她其实并非处女，却装得像处女一样。高中起，她就经常把男友带到神社发生性关系，还有在户外做爱的习惯。
